arguments.sql: SELECT c.has_chip, 1.0 * SUM(f.is_fraud) / COUNT(*) AS fraud_rate, COUNT(*) AS labelled_transactions, SUM(f.is_fraud) AS fraud_transactions FROM transactions t JOIN fraud_labels f ON f.transaction_id = CAST(t.id AS TEXT) JOIN cards c ON c.id = t.card_id GROUP BY c.has_chip ORDER BY c.has_chip
arguments.explanation: Shows the fraud rate on labelled transactions broken down by whether the card has a chip, with counts of labelled and fraud transactions for each group.
assumptions: Same measure as the earlier card-brand query: fraud rate over labelled transactions only, joined to cards through transactions.card_id.
has_chip is taken from the card (cards.has_chip), not from the transaction type.
